name: academic-peer-review
description: AI-assisted academic peer review: a panel of 3–8 independent reviewer agents with distinct roles (red-team critic, author advocate, methods & statistics, reproducibility & FAIR, domain), optionally on different models, after a deterministic audit (statcheck, OpenAlex/doi.org citations and retractions, FAIR, AI provenance, hidden content, target-journal scope) and a 3-axis classification (5 areas × 15 article types × 13 research approaches). Calibrated editorial meta-review and PDF report; output is a draft for human referees.

author.name: Prof. Dr. Fabiano Bezerra Menegidio (LaBiOmicS / UMC)
